title: Localize EmailVerificationConfirmPanel's title/Open-Email/Send-Again/Cancel text; stop pinning the English literals in its test suite
rule: AX-2 (no hardcoded user-facing strings; EN/HE parity)

evidence.quote:
//   These hardcoded English strings are reported in bugsFound as low-severity
//   i18n gaps. Tests assert the ACTUAL strings emitted by the widget.

expect(find.text('Open Email'), findsOneWidget);
        expect(find.text('Send Again'), findsOneWidget);

message:
          'This account exists only on this device. '

why: Both production callers (email_verification_dialog.dart and upgrade_to_cloud_screen.dart) never pass `title:`, so a Hebrew-locale user doing email verification sees the English dialog title 'Confirm Your Email' and the buttons 'Open Email' / 'Send Again' / 'Cancel' — this is an EN+Hebrew RTL app and the ARB parity check (1421/1421 keys) cannot catch this because these strings never became ARB keys. The test suite doesn't just miss this — email_verification_confirm_panel_test.dart's A1/A2/A5 assert the literal English strings as the expected/correct output, and its H1 Hebrew-locale test (currently skipped for an unrelated, now-fixed reason — see companion finding) would, if unskipped as written, assert `find.text('Open Email')` etc. under `locale: he`. Fixing the i18n bug would therefore break these 'passing' tests, actively disincentivizing the fix.
recommendation: Give EmailVerificationConfirmPanel access to AppLocalizations (accept the strings as required params from both call sites, mirroring how bodyText/verifiedLinkLabel already flow through, or call AppLocalizations.of(context) internally) using the existing `cancel` ARB key plus new keys for the title and the two action labels. Update the test file's assertions to build against l10n values (see offline_top_banner_l1_test.dart in this same batch for the correct pattern: `he.offlineBannerMessage` + a regression assertion that the pre-fix English literal is absent under `he`).
acceptance_criteria: email_verification_confirm_panel.dart contains no bare string literal passed to Text() for title/action labels; all route through AppLocalizations/ARB keys.
make arb-parity stays green with the new EN/HE keys added.

email_verification_confirm_panel_test.dart's Hebrew-locale test asserts the Hebrew strings render and the pre-fix English literals ('Open Email', 'Send Again', 'Cancel', 'Confirm Your Email') do NOT appear under locale: he.
A grep-based Rule-0 checker (extending the existing AX-2/arb-parity tooling) flags literal string arguments to Text()/TextSpan() in lib/features/**/presentation/** that are not ARB-key-derived.

corrections: The 'Send Again' quote is at line 298, not line 299 as stated in the finding's evidence array — a one-line offset. The quote text itself is exact and the defect is unaffected.
Minor line-number correction only: 'Send Again' literal is at email_verification_confirm_panel.dart:298, not :299 as cited. All other cited lines/quotes are exact.

mergedFrom: Route auth/onboarding validators and email-verification/no-backup UI strings through AppLocalizations instead of hardcoded English
